status: Design before inspecting the new mechanism evaluation cohort; formula, orientation, cold sign, common-support weights and model hashes to be sealed in a separate committed lock before scoring.
start: Frozen nonlinear four-symbol w3/b1 operator, seed 11. Distill on archived cold train/validation only without access to the outer species target. No kinetic prediction follows a priori; no trajectory test.
observable: One network-free block motif, selection by teacher fidelity rather than by its new physical outcome. Split its scalar value at the most balanced nontrivial train-calibration threshold (ties: lowest threshold). No alternate rule at evaluation.
response: Mean A-species fraction at the three sites reached by extending from the (-1,-1,-1) corner three lattice spacings outward along -z, -y and -x. Two unobserved layers. The target is outside every physical baseline feature's read set, including coordination and swap energies of edges fully inside the 3-cube.
baseline: Strong frozen conventional predictor includes ordinary species patterns/correlations, coordination and all internal nearest-neighbor swap barriers. Ordinary nested models separately scored. Real and conventional A-enrichments compared on the identical sites and parents.
primary: Within strata fixed by the ordered species pair at the two opposite corners, coordination number at the selected corner, and category of its smallest allowed internal swap energy (<=0,1..2,3..6,>=7,none), contrast residual Y-p_full between the high and low motif classes. Average strata using cold calibration harmonic overlap mass; require >=32 cases and >=8 distinct parents in each arm in each retained cold stratum. Preserve the same strata/weights at transfer. The prediction is a signed excess of >=0.002 in A occupancy (at least two extra A sites per thousand) at archived beta index 6, over the conventional model. Direction set once by cold calibration, reported even if cold validation is not supportive. A future cohort with insufficient support is inconclusive, never selectively rematched.
decision: A 95% parent-cluster interval strictly above +0.002 supports the proposed transferable effect for this outcome. Upper limit below +0.002 excludes that signed prediction; equivalence to within +/-0.002 requires both bounds inside that band. Interval crossing threshold is inconclusive. One primary endpoint. Publish observed and baseline contrasts, prediction error, supported probability mass, and 80%-power detectable increment (2.802*cluster SE) as distinct quantities. No inference about all possible order parameters.
uncertainty: Leave-one-whole-parent jackknife of the fixed-weight ratio-of-sums contrast, preserving all its anchors and targets together. Interval conditional on frozen trained models. No sites counted as independent samples.
secondary: Unmatched observed and conventional contrasts, held-out log score of adding the motif versus a matched one-parameter conventional polarization adjustment; not extra chances to pass. Temperature trend on discovery/diagnostic cohorts is descriptive. If the conventional model succeeds report a limit, not novelty.
